name: Crystal
seo_title: Crystal Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 2 Events, 1 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Crystal, MN for 2026: Winterfest with llamas and Santa plus the Robbinsdale tree lighting nearby.
lede: Crystal's Winterfest brings llamas, Santa and a tree lighting to the community center.
celebrates: The City of Crystal hosts Winterfest at the Crystal Community Center on December 5, a free afternoon of music, entertainment, indoor activities, refreshments, take-home crafts, llamas and Santa, ending with the Light Up Crystal tree lighting at 5 pm. Nearby Robbinsdale lights its City Hall tree on December 1 with carols, cider and Santa, and the Tri-City Santa Parade passes through Crystal that same Saturday evening.
lastyear: CCX Media, the local public access station, covered Winterfest 2026 with Santa, llamas and the Light Up Crystal tree lighting, and the city's What's New page lists the event with free family activities. Robbinsdale's city Facebook page announced its 2026 tree lighting two weeks ahead.
facts: Crystal Winterfest and Light Up Crystal share the community center at 4800 Douglas Drive North with the Crystal Cove Aquatic Center. The Tri-City Santa Parade begins in New Hope, winds through Crystal with sirens sounding and holiday music playing, and ends in Robbinsdale. Robbinsdale's tree lighting is traditionally the first Tuesday of December.
trains: We did not find a holiday train in Crystal. CPKC's Holiday Train stops in Golden Valley on December 14 at 5 pm. The Minnesota Streetcar Museum's Holly Trolley and the Twin City Model Railroad Museum are the nearest museum train experiences.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Crystal for 2026, and here is what he found: 2 family events across Crystal and Robbinsdale, 1 of them free. The magic runs from December 1 (Robbinsdale Annual Holiday Tree Lighting at City Hall) through December 5 (Crystal Winterfest and Light Up Crystal). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Crystal

  • 2 Christmas events for kids in Crystal, including 1 from Robbinsdale
  • 1 free event, Crystal Winterfest with llamas and Santa
  • Meet Santa: Crystal Winterfest and the Robbinsdale tree lighting
  • Parades and tree lightings: Light Up Crystal on December 5 and Robbinsdale on December 1
